title: Pencil with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='24' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- body shading stripe -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='7' height='52' rx='3' fill='#FFE98A'/>
  <rect x='56' y='18' width='6' height='52' fill='#E8A81C'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='24' height='12' rx='5' fill='#F97FB0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='24' height='5' rx='4' fill='#FFB3D1'/>
  <!-- metal band -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='24' height='6' fill='#C9D6E8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='24' height='2' fill='#EAF1FA'/>
  <!-- wood cone -->
  <polygon points='38,70 62,70 50,88' fill='#F2C48A'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='44,80 56,80 50,90' fill='#8E6BD1'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3A2A66'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3A2A66'/>
  <circle cx='45.2' cy='36.8' r='1.2' fill='#EAF1FA'/>
  <circle cx='57.2' cy='36.8' r='1.2' fill='#EAF1FA'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43,48 Q50,56 57,48' stroke='#3A2A66' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
